text: Margo cornered The Phantom in the shadowed alcove of the Louvre, her gun trained on the figure she believed to be her brother. However, as the dust settled, the figure stepped into the light, revealing not her sibling, but a sophisticated parrot perched on a mannequin dressed in The Phantom’s signature cloak. The bird, known for its ability to repeat what you say, squawked, "Sister, sister, catch me if you can," mimicking the voice of her long-lost brother perfectly. Margo lowered her weapon, realizing the true thief had used the bird’s mimicry to create the illusion of her brother’s presence, allowing the real Phantom to escape through a hidden passage while she was distracted by the emotional deception.
